name: Goodlyfe Infused Pre-Roll | Lemonade Kush
description: Lemonade Kush is a balanced hybrid strain that will keep your mind cool on what feels like a warm summer day. This strain has a fresh and tart flavor profile with notes of sweet citrusy lemon, as well as notes of earth and wood. Lemonade Kush will provide uplifting effects and a creative headspace. Its dominant terpenes are Limonene and ß-caryophyllene.
